---Code for ancylary part (Figure 1)---

This part of the code generates heatmaps of log2FC (W6/W0 + 1) proportions of memory subsets (Naive, CM, EM, TEMRA) for CD4 (Fig. 1g) and CD8 (Fig. 1h).
```{r , HM CD4 Pop Mem , fig.height=5, fig.width=15}
rm(list=ls())
data <- readxl::read_excel('C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/for_hm_CD4.xlsx')
data <- data[data$`Essai clinique` == "TICIMEL", ]
data_num <- data[, sapply(data, is.numeric)]
data_matrix_scaled <- t(scale(t(data_num)))
rownames(data_matrix_scaled) <- data$`Patient`
data_matrix_scaled_t <- t(data_matrix_scaled)

annotation_Réponse <- data$Réponse[match(colnames(data_matrix_scaled_t), data$`Patient`)]
annotation_cohort <- data$Cohorte[match(colnames(data_matrix_scaled_t), data$`Patient`)]

top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Cohort = factor(annotation_cohort),
  Response = factor(annotation_Réponse),
  
  col = list(
    Cohort = c("Ipi + Nivo + Certo" = "#5f4a95", "Ipi + Nivo + Inflix"= "#4570b6"),
    Response = c("R" = "darkgreen", "NR" = "darkred")
  ),
  
  annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 12)
)

colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu"))
colors.use <- colorRampPalette(colors)(100)
ordre_lignes <- c("Naive", "CM", "EM", "TEMRA")
data_matrix_scaled_t <- data_matrix_scaled_t[ordre_lignes, ]

heatmap <- Heatmap(
  data_matrix_scaled_t,
  name = "LOG2FC(W6/W0)+1)",
  column_title = "Patients",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  column_split = factor(annotation_cohort, levels = c("Ipi + Nivo + Certo", "Ipi + Nivo + Inflix")),
  top_annotation = top_annotation,
  col = colors.use,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 15)
)

draw(
  heatmap,
  heatmap_legend_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_side = "left",
  padding = grid::unit(c(2, 2, 2, 8), "cm")
)


svglite::svglite(
  "C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/Figure 1 TICIMEL (clinique 1)/heatmap_CD4_TICIMEL_only.svg",
  width  = 1900/150,  
  height = 700/150    
)
draw(
  heatmap,
  heatmap_legend_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_side = "left",
  padding = grid::unit(c(2, 2, 2, 8), "cm")
)
dev.off()

```

---Code for the analysis of MFI from TILs in B16OVA tumor-bearing WT mice (Figure 3)---

```{r clean and functions}
rm(list = ls())

# Fonction pour convertir proprement en numérique
convert_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    x <- gsub(",", ".", x) # Remplacer les virgules par des points si nécessaire
    x <- gsub(" ", "", x)  # Supprimer les espaces
    x <- as.numeric(x)     # Convertir en numérique
  }
  return(x)
}

# Fonction pour extraire uniquement le nom du marqueur (dernier élément après "___")
rename_columns <- function(col_names) {
  sapply(col_names, function(x) {
    if (grepl("___", x)) {
      return(sub(".*___", "", x))  # Garde seulement ce qui est après "___"
    } else {
      return(x)  # Garde les autres colonnes inchangées
    }
  })
}



```

This part of the code loads the MFI data of the CD4 regulatory cluster from the tumor the markers of interest (TIGIT, PD-1, CD39, CTLA-4 and PDL1). The data are then scaled for each marker to generate and a heatmap is generated(Fig.3.f), treatment (Bitherapy of Tritherapy) and tumor evolution from 7 are shown as annotations.
```{r Heatmap MFI CD4 regulatory cluster, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}

df <- read.csv('C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/MFI_Regulatory_CD4_Tumor.csv', sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(df) <- rename_columns(colnames(df))

df_HM <- df
df_HM[, setdiff(colnames(df_HM), c("file", "Treatment","file2"))] <- lapply(df_HM[,setdiff(colnames(df_HM), c("file", "Treatment","file2"))], convert_to_numeric)

df_HM <- df_HM %>%
  dplyr::select(-file) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("file2")

df_HM_t <- t(as.matrix(df_HM))
annotation_treatment <- df_HM$`Treatment`[match(colnames(df_HM_t), df$`file2`)]
annotation_tumor_evolution_fromJ7 <- df_HM$`Tumor_evolution_fromJ7`[match(colnames(df_HM_t), df$`file2`)]

df_HM_t <- df_HM_t[!rownames(df_HM_t) %in% c("Treatment", 
                                                   "Tumor_size",
                                                   "Tumor_evolution_frommax",
                                                   "Tumor_evolution_fromJ7",
                                                   "Tumor_volume_J17",
                                                   "Tumor_weight_J17"), ]

matrix <- apply(df_HM_t, 2, function(x) as.numeric(x))
rownames(matrix) <- rownames(df_HM_t)
matrix_scaled <- t(scale(t(matrix)))  

col_fun_tumor_evolution_J7 <- colorRamp2(c(min(annotation_tumor_evolution_fromJ7, na.rm = TRUE), 0, max(annotation_tumor_evolution_fromJ7, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                                       
                                        c("darkgreen", "white", "darkred"))


top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Treatment` = factor(annotation_treatment),
  `Tumor evolution from day 7 (log2FC)` = anno_barplot(
    annotation_tumor_evolution_fromJ7, 
    gp = gpar(fill = col_fun_tumor_evolution_J7(annotation_tumor_evolution_fromJ7), col = "black"),
    height = unit(2, "cm")
  ),
  col = list(`Treatment` = c("Bitherapy" = "#06AC8B", "Tritherapy" = "#675FAA")),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 12)
)

legend_tumor_evolution_J7 <- Legend(
  title = "Tumor evolution from day 7 (log2FC)",
  col_fun = col_fun_tumor_evolution_J7,
  at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), 
  labels = c("-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2"),
  direction = "horizontal",
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

markers_to_keep <- c("TIGIT.median", "PD.1.median", "CD39.median", "CTLA.4.median", "PDL1.median" ) 
filtered_matrix <- matrix_scaled[rownames(matrix_scaled) %in% markers_to_keep, ]
rownames(filtered_matrix) <- gsub("\\.median", ".MFI", rownames(filtered_matrix))



colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu"))
colors.use <- colorRampPalette(colors)(100)

heatmap1 <- Heatmap(
  filtered_matrix, 
  name = "zscore",
  column_title = "Mice",
  row_title = "Markers",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  top_annotation = top_annotation,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 15),
  column_split = factor(annotation_treatment, levels = c("Bitherapy", "Tritherapy")),
  show_column_names = F,
  col = colors.use,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    direction = "horizontal",
    title_position = "topcenter"
  )
)

draw(heatmap1, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "left", 
     annotation_legend_side = "left", 
     padding = unit(c(10, 10, 10, 10), "mm"), 
     legend_gap = unit(1, "mm"),
     annotation_legend_list = list(legend_tumor_evolution_J7)
)


svglite::svglite("C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/MFI_Regulatory_CD4_Tumor.svg",
  width  = 1900/150,  
  height = 700/150   
)
draw(
heatmap1, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "left", 
     annotation_legend_side = "left", 
     padding = unit(c(10, 10, 10, 10), "mm"), 
     legend_gap = unit(1, "mm"),
     annotation_legend_list = list(legend_tumor_evolution_J7)
)
dev.off()


```

```{r Heatmap MFI CD8 exhausted cluster, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
heatmap1 <- Heatmap(
```

---Code for the analysis of MFI from TILs in B16OVA tumor-bearing hTNFxhTNFR2 (Figure 4)---
```{r clean and functions}
rm(list = ls())

# Fonction pour convertir proprement en numérique
convert_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    x <- gsub(",", ".", x) # Remplacer les virgules par des points si nécessaire
    x <- gsub(" ", "", x)  # Supprimer les espaces
    x <- as.numeric(x)     # Convertir en numérique
  }
  return(x)
}

# Fonction pour extraire uniquement le nom du marqueur (dernier élément après "___")
rename_columns <- function(col_names) {
  sapply(col_names, function(x) {
    if (grepl("___", x)) {
      return(sub(".*___", "", x))  # Garde seulement ce qui est après "___"
    } else {
      return(x)  # Garde les autres colonnes inchangées
    }
  })
}



```

This part of the code loads the MFI data of the CD4 regulatory cluster from the tumor the markers of interest (TIGIT, PD-1, TIM-3, TOX, FOXP3, CD226). The data are then scaled for each marker to generate and a heatmap is generated(Fig.4.e), treatment (Bitherapy, Tri certo or Tri inflix) and tumor evolution from 6 are shown as annotations.
```{r Heatmap MFI CD4 regulatory cluster, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}

df <- read.csv("C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/MFI_regulatory_CD4_Tumor_humanised.csv", sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(df) <- rename_columns(colnames(df))
df_HM <- df


df_HM[, setdiff(colnames(df_HM), c("file", "Assigned_BOR", "Mouse_id", "OriginalFileName", "Tissue", "Upload.Folder","Treatment"))] <- lapply(df_HM[,setdiff(colnames(df_HM), c("file", "Assigned_BOR", "Mouse_id", "OriginalFileName", "Tissue", "Upload.Folder","Treatment"))], convert_to_numeric)

df_HM <- df_HM %>%
  dplyr::select(-file) %>%                
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Mouse_id")

df_HM_t <- t(as.matrix(df_HM))
annotation_treatment <- df_HM$`Treatment`[match(colnames(df_HM_t), df$`Mouse_id`)]
annotation_Log_Percentage_Change <- df_HM$`Log_Percentage_Change`[match(colnames(df_HM_t), df$`Mouse_id`)]
df_HM_t <- df_HM_t[!rownames(df_HM_t) %in% c("Treatment", 
                                                   "Tumor_size",
                                                   "Tumor_evolution_frommax",
                                                   "Log_Percentage_Change",
                                                   "Tumor_volume_J17",
                                                   "Tumor_weight_J17"), ]

matrix <- apply(df_HM_t, 2, function(x) as.numeric(x))
rownames(matrix) <- rownames(df_HM_t)
matrix_scaled <- t(scale(t(matrix))) 
col_fun_tumor_evolution_J7 <- colorRamp2(c(min(annotation_Log_Percentage_Change, na.rm = TRUE), 0, max(annotation_Log_Percentage_Change, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                                       
                                        c("darkgreen", "white", "darkred"))


top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Treatment` = factor(annotation_treatment),
  `Tumor evolution from day 7 (log2FC)` = anno_barplot(
    annotation_Log_Percentage_Change, 
    gp = gpar(fill = col_fun_tumor_evolution_J7(annotation_Log_Percentage_Change), col = "black"),
       ylim = c(-3, 3),          
    baseline = 0,       
    height = unit(2, "cm") 
  ),
  col = list(`Treatment` = c("Bitherapy" = "#46b9ab", "Certolizumab" = "#5f4a95", "Infliximab" ="#4570b6")),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 12)
)

legend_tumor_evolution_J7 <- Legend(
  title = "Tumor evolution from day 7 (log2FC)",
  col_fun = col_fun_tumor_evolution_J7,
  at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),  
  labels = c("-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2"),
  direction = "horizontal",
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

markers_to_keep <- c("Tigit.median", "Foxp3.median", "CD39.median", "Tim3.median", "Pd1.median", "Tox.median", "Cd226.median" )
filtered_matrix <- matrix_scaled[rownames(matrix_scaled) %in% markers_to_keep, ]
rownames(filtered_matrix) <- gsub("\\.median", ".MFI", rownames(filtered_matrix))
rdBu <- rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))


col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 11), 
  colors = rdBu
)


heatmap1 <- Heatmap(
  filtered_matrix, 
  name = "zscore",
  column_title = "Mice",
  row_title = "Markers",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  top_annotation = top_annotation,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 15),
  column_split = factor(annotation_treatment, levels = c("Bitherapy", "Certolizumab" ,"Infliximab")),
  show_column_names = F,
  col = col_fun,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    direction = "horizontal",
    title_position = "topcenter" 
  )
)


draw(heatmap1, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "left", 
     annotation_legend_side = "left", 
     padding = unit(c(10, 10, 10, 10), "mm"), 
     legend_gap = unit(1, "mm"),
     annotation_legend_list = list(legend_tumor_evolution_J7)
)


svglite::svglite("C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/MFI_regulatory_CD4_Tumor_humanised.svg",
  width  = 2700/150,  # 13.333 in
  height = 700/150    # 4.667 in
)
draw(
heatmap1, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "left", 
     annotation_legend_side = "left", 
     padding = unit(c(10, 10, 10, 10), "mm"), 
     legend_gap = unit(1, "mm"),
     annotation_legend_list = list(legend_tumor_evolution_J7)
)
dev.off()


```

This part of the code loads the MFI data of the CD8 exhausted cluster from the tumor the markers of interest (TIGIT, CD226, PD-1, CD39, TOX). The data are then scaled for each marker to generate and a heatmap is generated(Fig.4.e), treatment (Bitherapy, Tri certo or Tri inflix) and tumor evolution from 6 are shown as annotations.
```{r Heatmap MFI CD8 exhausted cluster, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}

df <- read.csv("C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/MFI_exhausted_CD8_Tumor_humanised.csv", sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# Appliquer la transformation aux noms de colonnes
colnames(df) <- rename_columns(colnames(df))
# Appliquer la conversion aux colonnes qui en ont besoin
df_HM <- df


df_HM[, setdiff(colnames(df_HM), c("file", "Assigned_BOR", "Mouse_id", "OriginalFileName", "Tissue", "Upload.Folder","Treatment"))] <- lapply(df_HM[,setdiff(colnames(df_HM), c("file", "Assigned_BOR", "Mouse_id", "OriginalFileName", "Tissue", "Upload.Folder","Treatment"))], convert_to_numeric)
# Convertir en data frame et gérer les rownames

str(df_HM)


df_HM <- df_HM %>%
  dplyr::select(-file) %>%                 # <- forcer le select de dplyr
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Mouse_id")

df_HM_t <- t(as.matrix(df_HM))

# Extraire les annotations
annotation_treatment <- df_HM$`Treatment`[match(colnames(df_HM_t), df$`Mouse_id`)]
#annotation_tumor_evolution_frommax <- df_HM$`tumor_evolution_frommax`[match(colnames(df_HM_t), df$`Mouse_id`)]
annotation_Log_Percentage_Change <- df_HM$`Log_Percentage_Change`[match(colnames(df_HM_t), df$`Mouse_id`)]
#annotation_tumor_weight_J17 <- df_HM$`tumor_weight_J17`[match(colnames(df_HM_t), df$`Mouse_id`)]
#annotation_tumor_volume_J17 <- df_HM$`Tumor_volume_J17`[match(colnames(df_HM_t), df$`Mouse_id`)]
# Supprimer la ligne "Treatment" si elle existe après la transposition
df_HM_t <- df_HM_t[!rownames(df_HM_t) %in% c("Treatment", 
                                                   "Tumor_size",
                                                   "Tumor_evolution_frommax",
                                                   "Log_Percentage_Change",
                                                   "Tumor_volume_J17",
                                                   "Tumor_weight_J17"), ]
# Convertir en matrice numérique et normaliser
matrix <- apply(df_HM_t, 2, function(x) as.numeric(x))
rownames(matrix) <- rownames(df_HM_t)
matrix_scaled <- t(scale(t(matrix)))  # Normalisation par ligne

col_fun_tumor_evolution_J7 <- colorRamp2(c(min(annotation_Log_Percentage_Change, na.rm = TRUE), 0, max(annotation_Log_Percentage_Change, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                                       
                                        c("darkgreen", "white", "darkred"))


top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Treatment` = factor(annotation_treatment),
  `Tumor evolution from day 7 (log2FC)` = anno_barplot(
    annotation_Log_Percentage_Change, 
    gp = gpar(fill = col_fun_tumor_evolution_J7(annotation_Log_Percentage_Change), col = "black"),
       ylim = c(-3, 3),                # <-- force l’échelle Y
    baseline = 0,       
    height = unit(2, "cm")  # Augmente la hauteur du barplot
  ),
  col = list(`Treatment` = c("Bitherapy" = "#46b9ab", "Certolizumab" = "#5f4a95", "Infliximab" ="#4570b6")),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 12)
)




# Créer une légende personnalisée pour Tumor Evolution from J7
legend_tumor_evolution_J7 <- Legend(
  title = "Tumor evolution from day 7 (log2FC)",
  col_fun = col_fun_tumor_evolution_J7,
  at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),  # Valeurs numériques de ta légende
  labels = c("-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2"),
  direction = "horizontal",
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)


####

# Liste des marqueurs que tu veux garder
markers_to_keep <- c("Tox.median", "Pd1.median", "Tigit.median", "Cd39.median", "Cd226.median" )  # ajoute d'autres noms si besoin

# Sélectionner uniquement les lignes dont le nom est dans la liste
filtered_matrix <- matrix_scaled[rownames(matrix_scaled) %in% markers_to_keep, ]

# Puis appliquer ta substitution sur les noms de lignes
rownames(filtered_matrix) <- gsub("\\.median", ".MFI", rownames(filtered_matrix))



rdBu <- rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))


# On définit les breaks symétriques autour de 0
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 11),  # -4, -3.2, ..., 4
  colors = rdBu
)





#Générer le heatmap

heatmap1 <- Heatmap(
  filtered_matrix, 
  name = "zscore",
  column_title = "Mice",
  row_title = "Markers",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  top_annotation = top_annotation,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 15),
  column_split = factor(annotation_treatment, levels = c("Bitherapy", "Certolizumab" ,"Infliximab")),
  show_column_names = F,
  col = col_fun,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    direction = "horizontal",
    title_position = "topcenter"  # optionnel pour un meilleur rendu
  )
)



# Sauvegarder en PDF 


draw(heatmap1, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "left", 
     annotation_legend_side = "left", 
     padding = unit(c(10, 10, 10, 10), "mm"), 
     legend_gap = unit(1, "mm"),
     annotation_legend_list = list(legend_tumor_evolution_J7)
)


svglite::svglite("C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/MFI_exhausted_CD8_Tumor_humanised.svg",
  width  = 2700/150,  # 13.333 in
  height = 700/150    # 4.667 in
)
draw(
heatmap1, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "left", 
     annotation_legend_side = "left", 
     padding = unit(c(10, 10, 10, 10), "mm"), 
     legend_gap = unit(1, "mm"),
     annotation_legend_list = list(legend_tumor_evolution_J7)
)
dev.off()


```


--- Buble plot for cluster identification (Extended data 5, 6, 7) ---

The codes below are used to generate bubble plots for the characterization and identification of different CD4 and CD8 T-cell clusters in the tumor or TDLN for 3 different experiments. The size of each bubble represents the mean percentage of marker-positive cells within each cluster, while the color represents MFI.

--Bubble plots bellow are for cytometry analysis of T cells from B16OVA tumor-bearing WT C57BL/6 mice treated with bitherapy or tritherapy--

The bubble plot bellow is for CD4 TILs clusters (Extended data 5.e)
```{r ID CLUSTERS CD4 Tumor MV, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
df <- read_csv("C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/for_buble_plot/buble_ID_CD4_Tumor_MV.csv")
exclude_cols <- c("Tumor_evolution_fromJ7", "Tumor_volume_J17", "Tumor_weight_J17")


df_numeric <- df %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(-any_of(exclude_cols))


df_mean <- df_numeric %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE))


col_info <- tibble(original = colnames(df_mean)) %>%
  mutate(
    format_type = case_when(
      str_detect(original, "___") ~ "mfi",
      str_detect(original, "/") ~ "percent",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    celltype = case_when(
      format_type == "mfi" ~ str_extract(original, "^[^|]+"),
      format_type == "percent" ~ str_extract(original, "^[^/]+"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    marker = case_when(
      format_type == "mfi" ~ str_extract(original, "___([^|]+)") %>% str_remove("___"),
      format_type == "percent" ~ str_extract(original, "/([^|]+)") %>% str_remove("/"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    stat = str_extract(original, "[^|]+$")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    marker = marker %>%
      str_replace_all("\\+", "") %>%
      str_replace_all("-", "") %>%
      str_to_upper()
  )


df_long <- df_mean %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "original", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(col_info, by = "original") %>%
  filter(!is.na(celltype), !is.na(marker), format_type %in% c("mfi", "percent")) %>%
  select(celltype, marker, format_type, value)


df_wide <- df_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = format_type,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mfi) & !is.na(percent))

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  mutate(
    mfi_zscore = (mfi - mean(mfi, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(mfi, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


mat_z <- df_wide %>%
  select(celltype, marker, mfi_zscore) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = mfi_zscore) %>%
  column_to_rownames("celltype") %>%
  as.matrix()

clust_rows <- hclust(dist(mat_z))$order
ordered_celltypes <- rownames(mat_z)[clust_rows]

clust_cols <- hclust(dist(t(mat_z)))$order
ordered_markers <- colnames(mat_z)[clust_cols]

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = ordered_celltypes),
    marker = factor(marker, levels = ordered_markers)
  )


selected_markers <- c("FOXP3",  "CD25", "CD127")
df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  filter(marker %in% selected_markers)


bubble_plot <- ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = marker, y = celltype, size = percent, fill = mfi_zscore)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    range = c(0, 14),
    name = "Percentage of expressing cells"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#46b9ab", "white", "#5f4a95"),
    name = "MFI (z-score per marker)",
    limits = c(min(df_wide$mfi_zscore, na.rm = TRUE),
               max(df_wide$mfi_zscore, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(size = 1.2, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "black"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5, colour = "black")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Tumor CD4 clusters identification",
    x = "Marker",
    y = "Tumor CD4 Cluster"
  )


ggsave("buble_ID_CD4_Tumor_MV.svg", plot = bubble_plot, device = "svg", width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)



bubble_plot

```

--Bubble plots for cytometry analysis of T cells from B16OVA tumor-bearing hTNFxhTNFR2 mice treated with bitherapy or tri certo or tri inflix--

The bubble plot bellow is for CD4 TILs clusters (Extended data 6.d)
```{r ID CLUSTER CD4 Tumor TMP humanised, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

df <- read_csv("C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/for_buble_plot/buble_ID_CD4_Tumor_TMP_humanised.csv")
exclude_cols <- c("Tumor_evolution_fromJ7", "Tumor_volume_J17", "Tumor_weight_J17")

df_numeric <- df %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(-any_of(exclude_cols))

df_mean <- df_numeric %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE))

col_info <- tibble(original = colnames(df_mean)) %>%
  mutate(
    format_type = case_when(
      str_detect(original, "___") ~ "mfi",
      str_detect(original, "/") ~ "percent",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    celltype = case_when(
      format_type == "mfi" ~ str_extract(original, "^[^|]+"),
      format_type == "percent" ~ str_extract(original, "^[^/]+"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    marker = case_when(
      format_type == "mfi" ~ str_extract(original, "___([^|]+)") %>% str_remove("___"),
      format_type == "percent" ~ str_extract(original, "/([^|]+)") %>% str_remove("/"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    stat = str_extract(original, "[^|]+$")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    marker = marker %>%
      str_replace_all("\\+", "") %>%
      str_replace_all("-", "") %>%
      str_to_upper()
  )


df_long <- df_mean %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "original", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(col_info, by = "original") %>%
  filter(!is.na(celltype), !is.na(marker), format_type %in% c("mfi", "percent")) %>%
  select(celltype, marker, format_type, value)


df_wide <- df_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = format_type,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mfi) & !is.na(percent))

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  mutate(
    mfi_zscore = (mfi - mean(mfi, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(mfi, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

mat_z <- df_wide %>%
  select(celltype, marker, mfi_zscore) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = mfi_zscore) %>%
  column_to_rownames("celltype") %>%
  as.matrix()

clust_rows <- hclust(dist(mat_z))$order
ordered_celltypes <- rownames(mat_z)[clust_rows]

clust_cols <- hclust(dist(t(mat_z)))$order
ordered_markers <- colnames(mat_z)[clust_cols]

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = ordered_celltypes),
    marker = factor(marker, levels = ordered_markers)
  )


selected_markers <- c("FOXP3",  "CD25", "CD127", "CD44", "PD1","KI67", "CD62L")
df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  filter(marker %in% selected_markers)


bubble_plot <- ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = marker, y = celltype, size = percent, fill = mfi_zscore)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    range = c(0, 14),
    name = "Percentage of expressing cells"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#46b9ab", "white", "#5f4a95"),
    name = "MFI (z-score per marker)",
    limits = c(min(df_wide$mfi_zscore, na.rm = TRUE),
               max(df_wide$mfi_zscore, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(size = 1.2, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "black"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5, colour = "black")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Tumor CD4 clusters identification",
    x = "Marker",
    y = "Tumor CD4 Cluster"
  )


ggsave("buble_ID_CD4_Tumor_TMP_humanised.svg", plot = bubble_plot, device = "svg", width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)


bubble_plot
```

The bubble plot bellow is for CD4 TILs clusters (Extended data 7.b)
```{r ID CLUSTER CD8 Tumor TMP infliximabs, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}

df <- read_csv("C:/Users/benjamin.jung/Desktop/for_buble_plot/buble_ID_CD8_Tumor_TMP_infliximabs.csv")

exclude_cols <- c("Tumor_evolution_fromJ7", "Tumor_volume_J17", "Tumor_weight_J17")


df_numeric <- df %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(-any_of(exclude_cols))

df_mean <- df_numeric %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE))


col_info <- tibble(original = colnames(df_mean)) %>%
  mutate(
    format_type = case_when(
      str_detect(original, "___") ~ "mfi",
      str_detect(original, "/") ~ "percent",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    celltype = case_when(
      format_type == "mfi" ~ str_extract(original, "^[^|]+"),
      format_type == "percent" ~ str_extract(original, "^[^/]+"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    marker = case_when(
      format_type == "mfi" ~ str_extract(original, "___([^|]+)") %>% str_remove("___"),
      format_type == "percent" ~ str_extract(original, "/([^|]+)") %>% str_remove("/"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    stat = str_extract(original, "[^|]+$")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    marker = marker %>%
      str_replace_all("\\+", "") %>%
      str_replace_all("-", "") %>%
      str_to_upper()
  )


df_long <- df_mean %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "original", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(col_info, by = "original") %>%
  filter(!is.na(celltype), !is.na(marker), format_type %in% c("mfi", "percent")) %>%
  select(celltype, marker, format_type, value)

df_wide <- df_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = format_type,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mfi) & !is.na(percent))

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  mutate(
    mfi_zscore = (mfi - mean(mfi, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(mfi, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

mat_z <- df_wide %>%
  select(celltype, marker, mfi_zscore) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker, values_from = mfi_zscore) %>%
  column_to_rownames("celltype") %>%
  as.matrix()

clust_rows <- hclust(dist(mat_z))$order
ordered_celltypes <- rownames(mat_z)[clust_rows]

clust_cols <- hclust(dist(t(mat_z)))$order
ordered_markers <- colnames(mat_z)[clust_cols]

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = ordered_celltypes),
    marker = factor(marker, levels = ordered_markers)
  )


selected_markers <- c("CD44", "CD62L", "PD1", "LAG3", "TIM3", "SLAMF6", "CD127", "CD39", "TBET", "KI67")
df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  filter(marker %in% selected_markers)


bubble_plot <-ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = marker, y = celltype, size = percent, fill = mfi_zscore)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    range = c(0, 14),
    name = "Percentage of expressing cells"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#46b9ab", "white", "#5f4a95"),
    name = "MFI (z-score per marker)",
    limits = c(min(df_wide$mfi_zscore, na.rm = TRUE),
               max(df_wide$mfi_zscore, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(size = 1.2, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "black"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5, colour = "black")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Tumor CD8 clusters identification",
    x = "Marker",
    y = "Tumor CD8 Cluster"
  )




ggsave("buble_ID_CD8_Tumor_TMP_infliximabs.svg", plot = bubble_plot, device = "svg", width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)



bubble_plot
```
